title: Subgradients for Non-Smooth Functions
seoDescription: Compute valid subgradients for absolute value, ReLU, and maximum functions at smooth and nonsmooth points.
description:
Evaluate subgradient set (subdifferential) for non-differentiable piecewise linear function f(x) = max(0, x).

$$
\partial f(x) = \begin{cases} \{1\} & x > 0 \\ \{0\} & x < 0 \\ [0, 1] & x = 0 \end{cases}
$$

Given input parameters `x`, return list of floats representing subdifferential set elements or interval bounds.
